value: The Blasted Lands are a country of exposed earth and old ruin, where Trebor’s defeat still has living consequences. Classic gives his story two introductions. The Alliance quest approaches him through a plea for common action against the Legion; the Horde chain follows lost orders and a courier’s report. These are separate faction paths, not one traveler’s shared itinerary. They meet at Trebor, whose concern has outlasted his own life: the soldiers he could not save.
editorNote: Alliance and Horde source variants are presented in one explicitly editorial opening; their characters and quests are not co-present or a single avatar route.
